items.title: Malicious App on The Google Play with 50K+ Downloads Deploy Anatsa Banking Malware
items.description: A dangerous banking malware called Anatsa has been discovered spreading through the Google Play Store, reaching more than fifty thousand downloads before detection. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-0709, stems from insufficient input validation in device firmware, potentially allowing attackers with valid credentials to execute arbitrary commands on affected systems.
